# Signal

> A courtyard building at 821 Traction Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90013, in the Arts District of Los Angeles. Thirteen shops, cafés, studios and offices share a planted courtyard and a roof deck. A 1910 warehouse rebuilt by Klein Agency for Raan Parton and Paolo Carini, opened in 2024.

- Address: 821 Traction Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90013
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/signalshops/
- Visit, parking and questions: https://signal-la.com/visit.html
- The building: https://signal-la.com/building.html

## Tenants

- [Departamento](https://signal-la.com/tenants/departamento.html): Clothing and designers. Designers, clothing, footwear and accessories. Enter through Concierge Coffee. Hours: Mon to Sat 10 to 5. Sun 12 to 5.
- [Concierge Coffee](https://signal-la.com/tenants/concierge-coffee.html): Coffee roaster and café. Roasted in the building. Poured at the bar. Hours: Mon to Fri 7 to 5. Sat and Sun 8 to 5.
- [Formas](https://signal-la.com/tenants/formas.html): Collectible design. Furniture and objects that do not sit still. Hours: Tue to Sat 11 to 5. Sun 12 to 5. Closed Monday.
- [Simon Miller](https://signal-la.com/tenants/simon-miller.html): Fashion. A Los Angeles label. Bags, shoes and ready-to-wear. Hours: Tue to Fri 11 to 5. Sat and Sun 10 to 5.
- [M5](https://signal-la.com/tenants/m5.html): Menswear. Italian and Japanese menswear, from technical outerwear to everyday basics. Hours: Tue to Sat 11 to 7. Sun 12 to 6.
- [Currently Running](https://signal-la.com/tenants/currently-running.html): Running apparel. Running clothes from California, cut from Italian fabric.
- [Alchemy Works](https://signal-la.com/tenants/alchemy-works.html): Shop and gallery. Coastal California, in clothing, objects and art. Hours: Daily 11 to 7.
- [Prune](https://signal-la.com/tenants/prune.html): Hair studio. Room for growth.
- [Beamz](https://signal-la.com/tenants/beamz.html): Ice cream and soda. Ice cream made from scratch, next door to Prune. Hours: Wed to Sun 2 to 10.
- [Klein](https://signal-la.com/tenants/klein-agency.html): Home store. Furniture, objects and records from the studio that designed Signal. Hours: Tue to Sun 11 to 5.
- [Flamingo Estate](https://signal-la.com/tenants/flamingo-estate.html): Heritage goods. Candles, soap and pantry goods from a hillside garden in Los Angeles.
- [Greycroft](https://signal-la.com/tenants/greycroft.html): Venture capital. A venture firm working from the Arts District.
- [Anine Bing](https://signal-la.com/tenants/anine-bing.html): Fashion label. The Los Angeles fashion label, at home in the Arts District.
